title: QA Engineer-CXA
description:
QA Test Engineer
  
  

Quality Engineering
  
  

ROLE OVERVIEW
  
  

MSIL is looking for a QA Automation Engineer with 3\-5 years of experience who is equally comfortable with manual/functional testing and automation. The role requires a clear, hands\-on understanding of core manual testing concepts (test case design, functional and regression testing, exploratory and UAT testing) along with the ability to build and maintain automation frameworks for UI, API, and database validation. The candidate will work across multiple projects simultaneously, coordinate closely with development teams on a day\-to\-day basis, and provide constructive feedback to help improve code quality and release readiness.
  
  

KEY ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

•
  
  

Demonstrate a clear, working understanding of manual and functional testing concepts, including test case design techniques such as boundary value analysis and equivalence partitioning.
  
  

•
  
  

Analyse business and functional requirements to prepare test scenarios, test cases, test data, and requirement traceability matrices.
  
  

•
  
  

Execute functional, regression, smoke, sanity, exploratory, system, and UAT\-support testing across web and API applications.
  
  

•
  
  

Validate bug fixes and enhancements manually before automation coverage is built out.
  
  

•
  
  

Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks (Page Object Model, Hybrid, Data\-Driven, Keyword\-Driven, BDD/Cucumber) for UI, API, and integration testing.
  
  

•
  
  

Automate web UI test cases using Playwright and/or Selenium WebDriver.
  
  

•
  
  

Build API automation using REST Assured, Postman, or Python\-based frameworks.
  
  

•
  
  

Develop database and ETL validation scripts using SQL (joins, stored procedures) to compare source and target systems.
  
  

•
  
  

Hands\-on experience in performance and load testing using K6/JMeter, including workload design, execution \& analysis of response time, throughput and error rates.
  
  

•
  
  

Performed security testing using OWASP Based practices and security scanning tools, supporting identification and remediation of application vulnerabilities.
  
  

•
  
  

Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps) and maintain test execution reports (Allure/Extent Reports).
  
  

•
  
  

Continuously identify opportunities to expand automation coverage and reduce repetitive manual testing effort.
  
  

•
  
  

Manage and prioritize testing activities across multiple concurrent projects/releases, balancing timelines without compromising quality.
  
  

•
  
  

Maintain strong, ongoing coordination with development teams throughout the SDLC to clarify requirements, discuss defects, and validate fixes quickly.
  
  

•
  
  

Provide clear, constructive feedback to developers on defects, code quality, and testability to support faster resolution and continuous improvement.
  
  

•
  
  

Collaborate with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and DevOps/SRE teams to align on quality standards and delivery timelines.
  
  

•
  
  

Participate actively in sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, estimation, retrospectives, and defect triage.
  
  

•
  
  

Review requirements and identify suitable automation candidates in collaboration with the team.
  
  

•
  
  

Perform root cause analysis on defects and track issues to closure, reporting quality metrics and test status to stakeholders.
  
  

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS
  
  

Manual \& Functional Testing
  
  

Test Case Design, Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, Functional/Regression/Smoke/Sanity Testing, Exploratory Testing, UAT Support
  
  

UI Automation
  
  

Playwright (Java/TypeScript)/ Selenium WebDriver — strong hands\-on expertise preferred
  
  

Programming
  
  

Java or Python
  
  

API Testing
  
  

REST API, REST Assured, Postman
  
  

Database
  
  

SQL, Stored Procedures, Joins, Database Validation, ETL validation using SQL
  
  

Frameworks / Design
  
  

TestNG, JUnit, PyTest; Page Object Model, Hybrid, Data\-Driven, Keyword\-Driven, BDD (Cucumber)
  
  

Visual Testing
  
  

Applitools or equivalent
  
  

CI/CD \& Version Control
  
  

Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Git, Maven, Gradle
  
  

Test/Defect Management
  
  

JIRA, Xray, TestRail, Confluence
  
  

Cloud Basics
  
  

AWS/Azure fundamentals
  
  

Other
  
  

XPath, CSS, DOM, and network debugging; Strong performance testing exposure (JMeter/K6\)
  
  

QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

•
  
  

Bachelor's degree (BE/B.Tech/M.Tech) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
  
  

•
  
  

3\-5 years of hands\-on experience in QA/test engineering, covering both manual and automation testing.
  
  

•
  
  

Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, SDLC, and STLC.
  
  

•
  
  

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to independently investigate and resolve technical issues.
  
  

•
  
  

Working knowledge of Windows and Linux environments.
  
  

•
  
  

Proven ability to manage multiple projects/priorities at the same time in a fast\-paced environment.
  
  

•
  
  

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work in Agile, cross\-functional, and globally distributed teams.
  
  

PREFERRED / GOOD TO HAVE
  
  

•
  
  

Experience with Docker and Kubernetes basics.
  
  

•
  
  

Exposure to AI\-assisted testing tools and techniques.
  
  

•
  
  

Familiarity with microservices, event\-driven architecture, and messaging systems (Kafka/RabbitMQ basics).
  
  

•
  
  

Awareness of security testing practices.
  
  

•
  
  

Experience with Agile/Waterfall project tracking tools (JIRA, qTest, Trello).
  
  

•
  
  

ISTQB Foundation Level certification.
  
  

KEY BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES
  
  

•
  
  

Strong coordination and communication skills to work closely with development, product, and business teams on a daily basis.
  
  

•
  
  

Ability to give clear, constructive, and actionable feedback to developers in a collaborative, non\-confrontational manner.
  
  

•
  
  

Comfortable managing and switching context across multiple projects/releases without losing attention to detail.
  
  

•
  
  

Ownership mindset with a proactive approach to identifying quality risks early in the SDLC.
  
  

•
  
  

Adaptable and willing to learn new tools, domains, and testing approaches quickly.
